files.doc:
🧰️ The scenario harness: the sign in, timed fetch, directory command and socket helpers the phases share.
 *
 * 🧱️ Child module of {@link ../🟦️.ts | the two-client document e2e}: a phase of the scenario over the same bindings, moved verbatim.

🌱️ Signing in both authors, creating the space, measuring the directory pages and creating the artifact.
 *
 * 🧱️ Child module of {@link ../🟦️.ts | the two-client document e2e}: a phase of the scenario over the same bindings, moved verbatim.

🔌️ Opening both sockets, presence replay, the first command, its remote delivery and the late join.
 *
 * 🧱️ Child module of {@link ../🟦️.ts | the two-client document e2e}: a phase of the scenario over the same bindings, moved verbatim.

🤖️ The agent delegation and revocation, presence lease expiry, resume and edit growth.
 *
 * 🧱️ Child module of {@link ../🟦️.ts | the two-client document e2e}: a phase of the scenario over the same bindings, moved verbatim.

🛑️ The receipt, the graceful shutdown and restart and the crash recovery of the hub.
 *
 * 🧱️ Child module of {@link ../🟦️.ts | the two-client document e2e}: a phase of the scenario over the same bindings, moved verbatim.

items.name: prepareScenarioHarness
items.doc: Waits for the hub and builds the sign in, timed fetch and directory command helpers.

items.name: createSpaceAndArtifact
items.doc: Signs in both authors, creates the space and artifact and measures the directory pages.

items.name: prepareSocketHelpers
items.doc: Builds the frame wait, grant mint and document socket open helpers.

items.name: runFirstCommandAndLateJoin
items.doc: Opens both sockets, replays presence, delivers the first command and checks the late join.

items.name: runAgentDelegationAndRevocation
items.doc: Delegates an agent session, commits its edit and checks revocation closes its socket and roster entry.

items.name: runPresenceExpiryAndGrowth
items.doc: Checks presence lease expiry, resumes a closed socket and grows the edit history before the restart.

items.name: runGracefulShutdown
items.doc: Writes the receipt notes, stops the hub gracefully and times its exit and restart spawn.

items.name: runCrashRecovery
items.doc: Kills the restarted hub and checks the writer release, the reopen and the recovered frontier.
